title: Two callables sharing __name__ in one module collapse into one registered task, silently, and the two registration paths disagree about which survives
author: vasilisnasopoulos
body_preview: ## Summary  A task's registered name is `f"{fun.__module__}.{fun.__name__}"` — `__qualname__` is never consulted. Two distinct callables that share `__name__` within one module therefore collapse into a single registered task, and a caller invoking the second one receives `SUCCESS` and the **first function's result**. title: 4.3.0: pool worker reports its own shutdown SystemExit as a task result, so acks_late tasks are acked and lost on cold shutdown
author: BrandonLewis
body_preview: ## Summary  Since 4.3.0, a pool worker catches the `SystemExit` that billiard's *own* shutdown handler raises and reports it as the task's result. Celery then treats the interrupted task as finished-with-failure and acknowledges its message, so a cold shutdown (SIGQUIT) silently discards in-flight work instead of returning it to the queue. With `task_acks_late=True` this is data loss on every rest...

title: RQ cron scheduler does not respect Django TIME_ZONE
author: chromium7
body_preview: ## Summary  Cron expressions registered through `django_rq` are evaluated in UTC instead of the timezone configured in Django's `TIME_ZONE`.  For example, with `TIME_ZONE = "Asia/Jakarta"`, a cron expression intended to run at `08:25` is scheduled for `08:25 UTC` and therefore runs at `15:25` Jakarta time.  ## Environment  - django-rq: 4.2.0 - rq: 2.12.0 - Django `TIME_ZONE`: `Asia/Jakarta` - Djan...
